remarks: Step into comfort and modern style with this move-in-ready gem, tucked away in a peaceful cul-de-sac in a quiet neighborhood. This thoughtfully updated home features a fully renovated kitchen with elegant quartz countertops, brand-new appliances, and stylish lighting fixtures. The brand new cabinets are equipped with LED lighting. The updates are complemented by fresh paint and new Lifeproof luxury vinyl flooring throughout. Enjoy added convenience with a laundry room designed for efficiency, complete with folding areas and ample storage. The home also features a new water heater, new washer and dryer, and updated bedroom and back doors. The bathroom has been beautifully redone with new tiling, a modern vanity, and a sleek medicine cabinet. Other upgrades include a new garage door opener and freshly speckled garage floor, adding both function and flair. The roof is just 10 years old, offering peace of mind for years to come. Located just minutes from High Ridge Road, you'll have easy access to Trader Joe's, restaurants, cafes, and everyday conveniences. Don't miss this opportunity to own a beautifully updated home in a desirable location.
